mentions.description: A web app (wateaminbox.com) centered on an inbox with support for channels. It has trial users and people who have messaged to thank the author, with plans to add support for more channels and work toward getting paid customers.

I am working on https://wateaminbox.com and https://learn-thai.ygncodelab.com. I got trial users who tried wateaminbox and some random people message and thanks for wateaminbox.

Planning to add more channels to wateaminbox and learning how to get paid customers.
mentions.author: uvu

mentions.name: WaTeamInbox
mentions.description: Unified team inbox for business messaging, initially built around WhatsApp and now expanding to Telegram bots, email, and MCP support, with Messenger, Instagram, Line, Viber, Discord, and Slack planned. It acts as a bridge between business communication channels and AI via MCP, and lets users create their own agents.
mentions.audience: Businesses (and individuals) bridging their messaging communication with AI via MCP
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://wateaminbox.com

Initially started as WhatsApp Team Inbox. But, now I am adding telegram bot, emails and MCP support. Eventually, I am going to add like Messenger, Instagram, Line, Viber, Discord, Slack, etc...

So, it will be a bridge between your/your business communication and AI via MCP. If you want to create your own agent you would be able to create as well.
mentions.author: uvu
